tagline: Read together, whatever edition you hold.

home.emptyBody: Creating and joining clubs comes in a later step. For now you're signed in, and that's what this step is for.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Join a club, log your page, leave notes for the others.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.nameHint: Shown to the people in your clubs.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.signup: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.
checkEmail.unverified: Confirm your email first. We sent a new link to {{email}}.
checkEmail.reset: If there's an account for {{email}}, we sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works for 1 hour.
checkEmail.spam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: You've been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work once, for 1 hour. Ask for a new one.

confirmed.title: Email confirmed
confirmed.invalidBody: Confirmation links work once, for 24 hours. Sign in and we'll send you a new one.

errors.passwordCompromised: This password has appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.googleNotLinked: This email already has a Bookclub account that isn't confirmed yet. Confirm it with the link we emailed, then Google sign-in will work too.
errors.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again, or use your email and password.

server.degraded: Server reachable, but its database is not answering
